subject: Samsung stack separates continuous geometry, fold semantics, lid/input, and display routing
body: Cross-agent finding from Samsung/framework forensics. Decompiled Samsung framework exposes Sensor.SEM_TYPE_FOLDING_ANGLE=65686, SEM_TYPE_FOLDING_STATE=65695, LID_ANGLE_FUSION_LOGGING=65696, LID_FOLDING_STATE_LPM=65697. Independent locked-Fold7 shell experiments report 65686/65695 registration false because com.samsung.permission.SSENSOR is signature|privileged, so Shizuku shell UID alone is not proof of access. Samsung InputManager.semGetLidState() is a synchronous IInputManager.getLidState() wrapper and has been readable from shell in a Fold7 experiment; its event listener is separately signature-gated by com.samsung.android.permission.LID_STATE. Samsung SemWindowManager.registerFoldStateListener delegates to DeviceStateManagerGlobal; SemWindowManager.isFolded() delegates IWindowManager.isFolded(), so SemWindowManager is not evidence of an independent continuous geometry source. Samsung SystemUI's HingeSensorAngleProvider registers default Sensor type 36 and DeviceFoldStateProvider consumes hinge values plus fold/screen state; PhysicsBasedUnfoldTransitionProgressProvider then springs angle/165 into animation progress. Therefore SystemUI progress must not be treated as raw physical angle without device proof. Agent03 consequence: correlate semantic fold callbacks separately from physical/logical display routing. Agent04: semGetLidState or fold-state logs may be useful edge timestamps but not presentation readiness. Agent01: prioritize direct registration proof for 65686 over assumptions; if denied, sensorservice vendor-event timestamps can at most be a motion hint, not geometry.
